name: CICD Health Dashboard Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: self-hosted

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Start Docker service
        run: |
          sudo systemctl start docker
          docker --version

      - name: Install dependencies (docker-compose + jq)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y docker-compose jq

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        run: echo "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" | docker login -u "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}" --password-stdin

      - name: Pull and start services with docker-compose
        run: |
          docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml pull
          docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d
          echo "Waiting for services to be healthy..."
          sleep 60
          docker ps          

      - name: Run health checks
        run: |
          curl -f http://localhost:5000/health || exit 1
          curl -f http://localhost:8080 || exit 1

      - name: Save job status for dashboard
        if: always()
        run: |
          START_TIME=$(date +%s)

          STATUS="success"
          if [ "${{ job.status }}" != "success" ]; then STATUS="failed"; fi

          echo "Waiting for backend to be ready..."
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5000/health >/dev/null; then
              echo "Backend is up!"
              break
            fi
            echo "Retrying in 5s..."
            sleep 5
          done

          END_TIME=$(date +%s)
          BUILD_TIME=$((END_TIME - START_TIME))

          echo "Recording pipeline status into Postgres (via backend API)..."
          curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/pipelines/cicd-status \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{
              \"name\": \"cicd-pipeline\",
              \"status\": \"$STATUS\",
              \"build_time\": $BUILD_TIME,
              \"branch\": \"${GITHUB_REF_NAME}\",
              \"commit_hash\": \"${GITHUB_SHA}\"
            }"

      # 🔹 NEW STEP: Backfill recent GitHub Actions runs (deduplication included)
      - name: Backfill recent GitHub Actions runs
        if: always()
        run: |
          THREE_DAYS_AGO=$(date -d "3 days ago" +%s)

          echo "Fetching last 10 runs from GitHub API..."
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs?per_page=10" \
          | jq -r '.workflow_runs[] | [.name, .conclusion, .head_branch, .head_sha, .run_started_at, .updated_at] | @tsv' \
          | while IFS=$'\t' read -r NAME STATUS BRANCH COMMIT START END; do
              
              START_TS=$(date -d "$START" +%s)
              END_TS=$(date -d "$END" +%s)

              # Skip runs older than 3 days
              if [ "$START_TS" -lt "$THREE_DAYS_AGO" ]; then
                echo "⏭️ Skipping old run: $NAME ($START)"
                continue
              fi

              # Convert GitHub conclusion to dashboard status
              if [ "$STATUS" == "success" ]; then STATE="success";
              elif [ "$STATUS" == "failure" ]; then STATE="failed";
              else STATE="$STATUS"; fi

              BUILD_TIME=$((END_TS - START_TS))

              echo "Checking if $COMMIT [$STATE] already exists in DB..."
              EXISTS=$(curl -s "http://localhost:5000/api/pipelines?name=$NAME&status=$STATE&branch=$BRANCH&commit_hash=$COMMIT" \
                | jq '.pipelines | length')

              if [ "$EXISTS" -gt 0 ]; then
                echo "✅ Already exists, skipping: $NAME ($COMMIT)"
                continue
              fi

              echo "🚀 Syncing run: $NAME [$STATE] ($BRANCH $COMMIT) build_time=${BUILD_TIME}s"

              curl -s -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/pipelines/cicd-status \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "{\"name\":\"$NAME\",\"status\":\"$STATE\",\"build_time\":$BUILD_TIME,\"branch\":\"$BRANCH\",\"commit_hash\":\"$COMMIT\",\"trigger_type\":\"github\"}" \
                || echo "⚠️ Failed to sync $NAME"
          done

      - name: Add summary with links
        run: |
          {
            echo "## 🚀 CICD Health Dashboard Deployment"
            echo ""
            echo "- **Status**: ${{ job.status }}"
            echo "- 🌐 Frontend UI: http://<YOUR_VM_EXTERNAL_IP>:8080"
            echo "- ⚙️ Backend API: http://<YOUR_VM_EXTERNAL_IP>:5000"
          } >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: Send Slack notification
        if: always()
        run: |
          STATUS="✅ SUCCESS"
          if [ "${{ job.status }}" != "success" ]; then STATUS="❌ FAILED"; fi
          curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
            --data "{\"text\":\"CICD Pipeline run on *${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}* (${GITHUB_REF_NAME}) - $STATUS\n🌐 Frontend: http://<YOUR_VM_EXTERNAL_IP>:8080\n⚙️ Backend: http://<YOUR_VM_EXTERNAL_IP>:5000\"}" \
            ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
